feature.name: STAND-IN Read a review's mood
feature.system: You read one product review from Larkfield, an online home and garden shop, and say how the buyer feels about the product overall. positive: happy with the product. negative: unhappy with the product. mixed: clear praise and a clear complaint about the product, with neither winning.

inputs.input: Does exactly what it says. The blades are sharp and it was half the price of the big brands.
Bought two for the patio. Sturdy, easy to put together, and they've survived a week of rain.
Lovely soft throw, washes well. My daughter has claimed it.
Arrived well packed. The colour matches the photos and the stitching is neat.
Third one I've bought from here. Never had a problem.
Stopped working after two days. Waste of money.
The handle snapped the first time I lifted it. Cheap plastic.
Nothing like the picture. Thin fabric and it smells of chemicals.
Leaks from the base. I've tried three washers and it still drips.
Wobbly, even after tightening every bolt. I wouldn't put anything heavy on it.
Looks beautiful on the table, but the lid doesn't fit and steam escapes everywhere. I'm torn on whether to keep it.
Great light, terrible battery. It lasts an evening at most. I can't decide if I'd buy it again.
The cushions are comfortable but the covers faded badly in a month. Half happy, half annoyed.
Cuts well and feels solid, yet the safety catch is so fiddly that I avoid using it. Mixed feelings.
Good size and a nice finish; the drawers stick badly. Three stars: as much good as bad.
Oh brilliant, another kettle that turns itself off before the water boils. Just what I wanted.
If you enjoy assembling furniture with missing screws and holes that don't line up, this is the wardrobe for you.
I expected it to be flimsy at this price. It isn't. Not a single complaint.
The courier was two days late and the box was battered, but the mirror itself is perfect and exactly what I wanted.

inputs.input: Five stars for the customer service, one star for the hedge trimmer, which is going back.

inputs.input: I wanted to love it. The design is clever. But it broke within a week and the replacement did too.
I was sceptical after the reviews here, but mine works fine and has done for six months. Happy.
Smaller than I pictured, which turned out to be a blessing: it fits the windowsill perfectly.
Would be perfect if it came in grey. As it is, still the best watering can I've owned.
Returned it. Enough said.
Heats the whole greenhouse in ten minutes and barely moves the meter. Very pleased.
Sturdy little step stool. Folds flat and holds my weight without a creak.
The duvet cover is as soft as the description says and the buttons are sewn on properly.
Easy to fit, looks smart, and the soft-close hinge actually works. Recommended.
My tomatoes have never done better than in these grow bags.
The zip broke on the second use and the seams are already fraying.
Rusted within a month of being outside. So much for weatherproof.
The timer is wildly inaccurate and the alarm is too quiet to hear from the next room.

fixes.line: Do not classify a review as mixed simply because it contains a minor complaint alongside praise or a compliment alongside a final rejection; judge the review as positive or negative based on the ultimate satisfaction with the product itself.
